description: Anthropic-compatible Messages API — Drop-in Anthropic Messages API shape (POST /v1/messages) served by Llama 3.3 70B on Workers AI. Body: {model, max_tokens (default 1024, max 4096), messages:[{role:user|assistant, content: string or text blocks}], system?, stop_sequences?, temperature?, top_p?, top_k?, stream?}. Returns {id, type:message, role:assistant, content:[{type:text,text}], stop_reason end_turn|max_tokens|stop_sequence, usage}. stream:true returns the standard SSE event sequence (message_start ... message_stop) in one response. Text only: image/document blocks and tools are rejected with 400 (never charged). Point an Anthropic SDK base_url at https://api.polyform.org. Price: $0.01 USDC (Base, via x402).
